acceptance: SnowflakeAdapter.__init__ accepts gateway (values from the manifest gateways declaration: native/espresso/greybeam/custom), gateway_host, gateway_port, gateway_protocol=https, gateway_ca_bundle, gateway_ocsp_fail_open=None, allow_insecure_gateway=False

gateway!=native requires gateway_host; allow_insecure_gateway or http-on-non-loopback requires BENCHBOX_ALLOW_INSECURE_GATEWAY=1 plus loud warning; ocsp forwarded only when not None; missing CA bundle file raises

Gateway mapping centralized in _get_connection_params so create_connection AND _create_admin_connection route via gateway; account always passed; insecure maps to insecure_mode; CA bundle via scoped REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE; userinfo stripped from hosts

Gateway selection uses the core gateway setting and validator from core-exec-gateway-capability (no adapter-level choice list or separate --gateway definition); the gateway connection options are registered only for Snowflake through that item's mechanism and are not exposed via MCP; test_advertised_platform_options passes
No live-vendor calls in tests; mock tokens only
context: Delivered in merged PR #3375: Snowflake gateway endpoint override (host/TLS/CA-bundle/insecure settings fail closed), CLI --gateway for Snowflake only, routed results classed unofficial_nonstandard with TPC Power/Throughput/QphH not computed. Not done / follow-ups: CLI --gateway for Databricks (GATEWAY_ROUTED_PLATFORMS stays Snowflake-only because the Databricks adapter forwards only `gateway`, not gateway connection options); gateway_protocol default leaking, security-class field on PlatformOptionSpec, CLI-parse-time rejection (unaddressed hygiene gaps). Live Snowflake gateway run not performed.
description: Add gateway-endpoint override to SnowflakeAdapter per plan v2 A1-A5, on top of the core gateway capability (core-exec-gateway-capability): config params and validation, centralized gateway mapping in _get_connection_params covering benchmark and admin paths, and from_config fields. The gateway choice itself (--gateway and its allowed values) comes from the core setting and the manifest gateways declaration; this item registers only the Snowflake gateway connection options through the mechanism that item defines, not separate adapter CLI args or _OPTION_SPEC_ROWS choice lists.
